purpose: Generated-cloud evaluation reference; source artefacts are acquired on demand and their SHA-256 receipts are required before evaluation.

metrics.operator: linear generated spectral radiance convolved with the ABI C02 spectral response, then converted to TOA reflectance with solar zenith and atmospheric-path correction
generated liquid or ice optical thickness sampled on the satellite footprint and compared with the matching cloud-product retrieval
generated uppermost optically effective cloud height converted to the retrieval's geopotential-height definition, sampled on the satellite footprint, then compared with ACHA HT
generated phase is binned into the cloud-product liquid, mixed, ice, and unknown categories without inferring phase from RGB
generated common cloud support is aggregated over each sensor footprint and compared with the cloud-mask fraction
tone-mapped RGB is used only to derive the common morphology mask; component diameters retain the observation projection and valid mask
orientation is measured from the projected morphology mask after removing the projection Jacobian

metrics.quantity: cloud-mask correlation at fixed and advected coordinates
metrics.operator: cloud-support masks are correlated at 10, 30, 60, and 180 minute lags; optical flow is not interpreted as physical wind

source.product: GOES-18 ABI L1b Radiances Full Disk and matching ABI L2 cloud products

checksum.scope: SHA-256 of SHA256SUMS containing a SHA-256 for every retained NetCDF file

observation.processingVersion: ABI L1b RadF collection as named by the retained NetCDF global attributes

angles.solar: per-pixel solar zenith and azimuth at observation time

observation.parallaxCorrection: cloud-top-height product displacement projected along the per-pixel satellite line of sight
observation.validMask: product-specific good-only DQF, navigation valid, outside limb; visible metric also requires solar zenith <= 70 deg and each retrieval uses its own cloud mask

calibration.reflectance: ABI C02 solar irradiance and Earth-Sun distance
calibration.toneMapping: morphology only; excluded from radiance metrics
